title: PoppySkillIndex
description: The optional skill_index in the tasks response (spec 9.4). Local validation of the Agent Skills discovery proposal pinned by the spec, not an upstream-published JSON Schema. Unknown schema versions remain opaque to clients.

type.description: skill-md or archive. Clients skip unknown types.

url.description: An HTTPS URL or a relative reference resolved against the final poppy.json URL. Clients check the resolved URL and every redirect under spec section 3.
